'''Cydera trees''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phaseera]].

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cydera tree first appeared in the novel ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and released on [[September 26]], [[2006]].
